tutorial.welcomeDesc: Welcome to Stratum 3D. This interactive experience lets you explore Earth. Let's go over the controls.
tutorial.navDesc: Click and drag to rotate the globe and survey the surface.
tutorial.navMobileDesc: Swipe horizontally to rotate the globe and survey the surface.
tutorial.zoomDesc: Use the zoom slider to adjust your viewing height. At maximum zoom, your coordinates lock automatically.
tutorial.coordsDesc: Your latitude and longitude are tracked in real-time. Lock them at max zoom to resolve a surface location.
tutorial.surfaceDesc: With coordinates locked, the descent button activates. Click it to transition to ground level and explore the terrain.
tutorial.exploreDesc: Scroll down to discover the technology powering Stratum 3D and what's on the horizon.
tutorial.completeDesc: You're all set. Enjoy the view.

about.label: 01 — About
about.p1: Stratum 3D is an interactive orbital experience that lets you explore Earth from the vacuum of space. Navigate the globe, lock onto coordinates, and plunge through the atmosphere in a cinematic descent sequence.
about.p2: Built entirely with WebGL and real-time 3D rendering, every interaction — from the axial tilt of the planet to the night-side city lights — is computed live in your browser. No pre-recorded footage. No static images. Pure geometry and shaders.
about.stat1Desc: Custom fragment shaders for procedural day/night cycles
about.stat2Desc: Real-time rendering target on modern hardware

ThreeJs.description: WebGL-powered 3D rendering with custom GLSL shaders for night-side illumination and atmospheric effects.

ReactThreeFiber.description: React renderer for Three.js enabling a component-driven architecture for the entire orbital scene.

MapLibreGL.description: Open-source vector tile engine with 3D terrain extrusion and building geometry for surface inspection.

GSAP.description: ScrollTrigger-powered transitions for the landing page. Precise easing curves for cinematic motion.

Vite.description: Lightning-fast HMR and optimized production builds with native ESM support.

TypeScript.description: End-to-end type safety across the 3D scene graph, map engine, and UI layer.

PhaseI.title: Orbital Mechanics
PhaseI.description: Realistic Earth rendering with axial tilt, cloud layers, night-side illumination, and full orbital camera controls.

PhaseII.title: Atmospheric Descent
PhaseII.description: Cinematic dive sequence with FOV warping, speed lines, warp tunnel shader, and seamless transition to the map engine.

PhaseIII.title: Landing Page & Presentation
PhaseIII.description: Scroll-driven landing page with GSAP animations, zoom slider controls, and polished section architecture.

PhaseIV.title: Friend Location System
PhaseIV.description: Real-time location sharing on the 3D globe. Mark distance and draw connection lines between you and your friends' orbital coordinates.

footer.description: A cinematic, real-time WebGL orbital exploration experience. Descend from the vacuum of space to the surface of the Earth.
